# Clipchamp

> > Microsoft's AI-powered online video editor with free tools for recording, editing, and enhancing videos for social media, education, and professional content.

Clipchamp is a comprehensive browser-based video creation platform that combines recording capabilities (webcam and screen), AI-powered editing features, and a rich library of templates and assets. It supports multiple video formats and platforms including YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and PowerPoint integration.

## Key Topics

- AI video editing
- Screen recording
- Webcam recording
- Auto subtitles
- Text-to-speech voiceovers
- Video trimming and cropping
- Green screen chroma key
- Audio enhancement
- Social media content creation
- Video resizing
- Brand kit management
- Online editor
- Content creation
- Accessibility features
- Multi-platform support

## Core Editing Platform

- [Online video editor by Microsoft Clipchamp](https://clipchamp.com/en): Microsoft Clipchamp homepage: AI-powered video editor with templates, stock assets, and multi-platform support.
- [Free online video editor | Microsoft Clipchamp](https://clipchamp.com/en/video-editor): Free online video editor with AI features, templates for YouTube, Instagram, and corporate content.
- [AI video editing features | Clipchamp online editor](https://clipchamp.com/en/ai-video-editing-clipchamp): AI-powered video editing tools: voiceovers, auto subtitles, noise removal, background remover.

## Recording Tools

- [Webcam recorder](https://clipchamp.com/en/webcam-recorder): Free online webcam recorder for video creation and editing without downloads.
- [Online screen and camera recorder](https://clipchamp.com/en/screen-recorder): Record screen and webcam for presentations, trainings, and social media content.
- [Online voice and audio recorder](https://clipchamp.com/en/voice-recorder): Record, edit, and enhance voice with AI noise removal for voiceovers and podcasts.

## AI-Powered Features

- [AI voiceover generator | Text to speech for video](https://clipchamp.com/en/features/ai-voice-over-generator): AI text-to-speech voiceover generator for videos, social media, and educational content.
- [Auto subtitle generator online | Free in over 100 languages](https://clipchamp.com/en/subtitle-generator): AI auto-subtitle generator supporting 100+ languages with transcript download capability.
- [AI audio enhancer | Improve sound clarity with audio cleanup and effects](https://clipchamp.com/en/audio-enhancer): AI audio enhancer for noise removal, speech clarity, and sound quality improvement.

## Video Editing Tools

- [Video trimmer | Cut and trim videos online](https://clipchamp.com/en/video-trimmer): Free online video trimmer with AI silence removal for perfect video length.
- [Crop a video online](https://clipchamp.com/en/crop-video): Free online video cropper for social media with edge and border removal.
- [Online video resizer | Easily change video aspect ratios](https://clipchamp.com/en/features/online-video-resizer): Video resizer with aspect ratio presets for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok.
- [Green screen video editor | Clipchamp](https://clipchamp.com/en/features/green-screen-video-editor): Green screen chroma key editor for removing and changing video backgrounds.
- [Online video enhancer | Adjust color correction and video brightener for free](https://clipchamp.com/en/video-enhancer): Free video quality enhancer with color correction, filters, and brightness adjustment.

## Design & Effects

- [Video overlay online | Overlay text, images & video effects online](https://clipchamp.com/en/video-overlay): Add customizable text, image, and video overlays with effects and blending modes.
- [Add stickers to video | Free emojis, animated graphics, vector shapes, and text stickers](https://clipchamp.com/en/add-stickers-to-video): Add animated graphics, emojis, text stickers, and vector shapes to videos.
- [Free audio visualizer | Music and voice visualizer online](https://clipchamp.com/en/features/audio-visualiser): Audio visualizer for music and podcast videos with reactive soundwave animations.
- [Brand kit tool](https://clipchamp.com/en/brand-kit): Brand kit for managing logos, color palettes, and fonts across videos.

## Conversion & Utilities

- [GIF Maker](https://clipchamp.com/en/gif-maker): Convert MP4, YouTube videos, and images to GIFs quickly and easily.
